title: Word Formation: Protecting Endangered Animals (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: The populations of many wild species have fallen 1.1. _________ over the last fifty years. Tigers, rhinos and certain gorillas are now facing complete 1.2. _________ in the wild. In response, dozens of 1.3. _________ projects have been set up to save them. One of the biggest threats comes from 1.4. _________, the illegal hunters who kill animals for their skins, horns or tusks. Charities work hard at raising public 1.5. _________ so that ordinary people understand the dangers. Many governments have created large 1.6. _________ areas where hunting is strictly forbidden. Because wildlife crime crosses borders, countries must act 1.7. _________ rather than alone. Encouragingly, a few breeding programmes have proved remarkably 1.8. _________, and some species are slowly recovering.
